title: AI-Brains grok-hook payload
description: JSON payload passed to `ai-brains grok-hook --payload`. Encodes a Grok Build session for message-only ingest from chat_history.jsonl.

historyPath.description: Absolute path to chat_history.jsonl. May be empty — resolved from sessionId + workspaceRoot/cwd via GROK_HOME.

sessionId.description: Grok session UUID. Used for delta-sync and turn-id namespace.

projectHash.description: Workspace path or `grok-unbound` when unbound. Normalized via ai-brains-path for alias keys.

workspaceRoot.description: Optional workspace root for path resolve when historyPath is empty.

cwd.description: Optional cwd fallback for path resolve.
